info.title: Comtrade Tools
info.description: APIs Tools to get some trade indicators. A subscription key is required.  https://uncomtrade.org/docs/un-comtrade-tools/

get.description: (EXPERIMENTAL - USE SPARINGLY) Extract trade data in a pivoted flow (exports and imports) layout. See the detailed description at https://uncomtrade.org/docs/list-of-references-parameter-codes/

parameters.name: typeCode
parameters.description: Type of trade: C for commodities and S for service

parameters.name: freqCode
parameters.description: Trade frequency: A for annual and M for monthly

parameters.name: clCode
parameters.description: Product classifications: HS, SITC, BEC (for goods) or EBOPS (for services).

parameters.name: reporterCode
parameters.description: Reporter code (Possible values are code of the countries separated by comma (,))

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: Year or month. Year should be 4 digit year. Month should be six digit integer with the values of the form YYYYMM. Ex: 201002 for 2010 February. Multi value input should be in the form of csv (Codes separated by comma (,))

parameters.name: partnerCode
parameters.description: Partner code (Possible values are code of the countries separated by comma (,))

parameters.name: partner2Code
parameters.description: Second partner/consignment code (Possible values are code of the countries separated by comma (,))

parameters.name: cmdCode
parameters.description: Commodity code. Multi value input should be in the form of csv (Codes separated by comma (,))

parameters.name: customsCode
parameters.description: Customs code. Multi value input should be in the form of csv (Codes separated by comma (,)) Allowed values: C00, C01, C02, C03, C04, C05, C06, C07, C08, C09, C10, C11, C12, C13, C14, C15, C20. Omit to not filter.

parameters.name: motCode
parameters.description: Mode of transport code. Multi value input should be in the form of csv (Codes separated by comma (,)) Allowed values: 0, 1000, 2000, 2100, 2200, 2900, 3000, 3100, 3200, 3900, 9000, 9100, 9110, 9120, 9190, 9200, 9300, 9900. Omit to not filter.

parameters.name: aggregateBy
parameters.description: Add parameters in csv list on which you want the results to be aggregated. Comma-separated list of: cmdCode, period, partnerCode, partner2Code, reporterCode, customsCode, motCode

parameters.name: breakdownMode
parameters.description: Mode to choose from

parameters.name: includeDesc
parameters.description: Include descriptions of data variables

401.description: Missing or invalid subscription key (API Management).

403.description: Free-tier user not on the allow-list ("User not allowed"), or APIM quota / access denial.

429.description: Rate limit exceeded (API Management). See the Retry-After header.

get.description: (EXPERIMENTAL - USE SPARINGLY) Extract basic trade data joined with mirror partner data. Useful to analyze bilateral trade asymmetries. See the detailed description at https://uncomtrade.org/docs/list-of-references-parameter-codes/

parameters.name: typeCode
parameters.description: Type of trade: C for commodities and S for service

parameters.name: freqCode
parameters.description: Trade frequency: A for annual and M for monthly

parameters.name: clCode
parameters.description: Product classifications: HS, SITC, BEC (for goods) or EBOPS (for services).

parameters.name: reporterCode
parameters.description: Reporter code (Possible values are code of the countries separated by comma (,))

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: Year or month. Year should be 4 digit year. Month should be six digit integer with the values of the form YYYYMM. Ex: 201002 for 2010 February. Multi value input should be in the form of csv (Codes separated by comma (,))

parameters.name: partnerCode
parameters.description: Partner code (Possible values are code of the countries separated by comma (,))

parameters.name: cmdCode
parameters.description: Commodity code. Multi value input should be in the form of csv (Codes separated by comma (,))

parameters.name: flowCode
parameters.description: Trade flow code. Multi value input should be in the form of csv (Codes separated by comma (,))

parameters.name: includeDesc
parameters.description: Include descriptions of data variables

401.description: Missing or invalid subscription key (API Management).

403.description: Daily quota exhausted, or the subscription does not include API access (API Management).

429.description: Rate limit exceeded (API Management). See the Retry-After header.

ErrorResponse.description: Error body returned by the backend with a 4xx/5xx status.

details.description: Per-parameter validation failures (400 only); null otherwise.

GatewayError.description: Returned by API Management before the request reaches the backend.

TradeBalanceRecord.description: One row of trade balance: X = exports, M = imports, primaryValueBal = X - M.

TradeBalanceResponse.description: Response envelope; data holds trade balance rows.

BilateralDataRecord.description: One row of bilateral data: reported values alongside the partner's mirror values.

BilateralDataResponse.description: Response envelope; data holds bilateral data rows.

note.description: Data-gap note for the requested reporters/partners, if any.
